findings.evidence: The page requires four P pages whose current plan entries have `items: []` and whose page files are absent: `countability-and-uncountability`, `product-measures-and-the-fubini-tonelli-theorems`, `euclidean-surface-measure-divergence-and-green-identities`, and `measures-and-their-basic-properties`. Their page-level statements and proofs cannot be inspected. The published item suppliers support the local arguments but do not discharge these declared page dependencies.

[F5] states the Lie-derivative identity for an arbitrary vector field but cites `lem-tgr-isometry-natural-tensor-invariance`, whose Statement assumes a nowhere-zero Killing field. In step 4.1, `K=(s/L_0)∂_s` is conformal Killing, not Killing, so that cited statement does not establish the identity used to compute `L_K g`. Add a general identity supplier or derive it from the flow definition.

The term `conformal Killing` is used before it is defined. `def-gr-killing-field` defines only the Killing condition `L_X g=0`; the equation `∇_(a β_{b)}=λg_{ab}` appears later as a property of the constructed field, not as a definition of the class used in Statement (c). Define the conformal-Killing equation and regularity of its conformal factor before using the term.

The item uses `future null shell` and `null-shell Liouville equation` without defining the massless shell or its domain. `def-tgr-future-mass-shell-measure` applies only to `M_*>0`; pointwise future-null definitions do not define the shell over the stated spacetime region. Define the nonzero future-null fiber set and its total domain before stating the transport claim.
